task_instance: Humanize an AI-sounding 'About our company' marketing blurb: detect the AI-writing patterns listed in the humanizer SKILL.md and rewrite the text to sound natural and human, preserving meaning.
evidence: The humanizer skill is a pure text-editing task whose allowed-tools are only Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob/AskUserQuestion, all satisfiable in this office-assistant runtime (no code execution, scripts, binaries, or network needed). Created a realistic AI-sounding sample input at input_ai_text.md (company About page exhibiting inflated-significance phrasing, promotional language, vague attribution, superficial -ing clauses, a negative parallelism, rule-of-three, AI-vocabulary words, a formulaic Challenges-and-Future-Prospects section, a title-case heading, an emoji, bold inline-header bullets, three em dashes, a generic upbeat conclusion, and a chatbot sign-off). Produced the deliverable at humanized_output.md applying the skill's Process: rewrote each flagged section into natural prose, fixed the heading to sentence case, removed all em dashes/emojis/boldface, converted the bullet list to prose, replaced vague claims with concrete specifics, and added human voice. Documented the full mapping of SKILL.md pattern numbers to fixes in changes_summary.md. Verified the deliverable by re-reading humanized_output.md: no em dashes, no emojis, no curly quotes, no markdown bold, sentence-case heading, no 'Despite...Despite these challenges' construction, and promotional/AI vocabulary removed. Files produced: input_ai_text.md, humanized_output.md, changes_summary.md, result.json in the work directory.
